title: Core Hub realtime — shared definitions
description: Entity shapes shared by every event payload. GENERATED from packages/contracts/openapi.yaml components.schemas by `pnpm contracts:generate` (rewriting #/components/schemas/X to #/$defs/X); do not edit by hand. Also defines the event envelope.

Ulid.description: 26-character Crockford base32 ULID, sortable by creation time.

ProfileSlug.description: Workspace (profile) slug — lowercase letters, digits and dashes.

Locale.description: UI language. Content direction is decided per string by the client, never by this value.

Money.description: Decimal amount as a string plus ISO-4217 currency.

Error.description: The one error envelope. Clients branch on `code`, show `error` verbatim.

error.description: Human sentence in the request language (`Accept-Language`).

ErrorCode.description: Fixed list. Adding a code is a contract change.

Scoped.description: Fields every row a client can show carries (ARCHITECTURE §Data ownership).

Page.description: Envelope of every list. `items` is typed per operation.

next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` to fetch the next page; `null` when there is none.

Avatar.description: A picture for a person, agent or profile. `generated` avatars are drawn by the client from `seed`.

url.description: Fetchable with the bearer token when `kind = image`.

AvatarInput.description: Set an avatar. `image` carries a data URL (≤ 512 KB); `generated` resets to the seed; `null` resets to default.

LocalizedText.description: A short text kept in both UI languages (release notes, notices generated by the server).

examples.ar: إصلاح انقطاع البث عند ضعف الشبكة
examples.en: Fix streaming drop on weak networks

JobAccepted.description: Body of every `202`. Operations add the ids of resources they created.

name.description: Display name the owner set (defaults to "Core Hub").

contract_version.description: The `info.version` of the OpenAPI document the server implements.

setup_required.description: True until the owner account exists (first boot).

percent.description: `null` when the work has no measurable progress (a run).

message.description: Human progress line in the requester's language.

ResourceRef.description: Reference to the entity a job or event is about.

resource.description: The entity the job is about; `null` for work with no single subject (a host-wide agent discovery).

profiles.description:
Slugs the user may enter. Owners and admins enter every profile, so theirs lists all
of them. A member's is exactly the list an admin gave them — nothing is added
implicitly, not by a profile created later — and empty means the member may enter no
profile at all (they can sign in, and every scoped request answers
`profile_not_found` with `details.reason = no_profile_granted`). With an empty
list `default_profile` still reads `default`, which that member cannot enter:
clients decide from `profiles`.

refresh_token.description: Rotating; `null` when an app token was renewed instead.

profiles.description:
The profiles a member may enter — an explicit list, never "all". Required with at
least one slug when `role` is `member` (the server answers `400 validation_failed`
with `details.field = profiles` otherwise; the rule depends on `role`, so it is
stated here rather than as `minItems`). Ignored for an admin, who enters every
profile.

Replaces the member's explicit list. An empty list withdraws every profile: the
member can still sign in and enters nothing. Changing `role` from `admin` to
`member` must carry at least one slug here in the same request (`400
validation_failed`, `details.field = profiles`, otherwise), because an admin holds
no list.

Preferences.description: Human-owned settings, global to the user (not per workspace).

busy_input_mode.description: What "send" does while a run is active (maps to `RunCreate.when`).

reasoning_effort.description: Default for new sessions; `null` lets the agent decide.

dictation_language.description: `auto`, `app` (follow the UI locale) or a BCP-47 tag.

PairingConnection.description: `lan` when the device reaches the hub directly; `relay` when it goes through the message relay.

qr_payload.description: JSON to encode in the QR: `{ type: "corehub.pairing", hub_url, pairing_id, code, expires_at }`.

clone_from.description: Copy agent settings, models and defaults from this profile (not sessions).

compression.description: Context compression applied to long sessions.

appearance.description: The server-side theme shown on the `Theme` screen.

ProfileSettingsPatch.description: Any subset of the sections; each section is merge-patched.

SessionSource.description: Where a session came from. `channel` sessions carry the platform in `channel`.

SessionStatus.description: `waiting` means a run is blocked on an approval or question.

window_tokens.description: `null` when the model's window is unknown.

title.description: `null` until the user or the server names it; clients show "New chat".

origin.description: The room, task, schedule or workflow run this session serves.

working_dir.description: Absolute path on the hub host the agent works in.

notify.description: Push a notice to the user's devices when a run in this session finishes.

runs.description: Active and queued runs, in execution order.

SessionPatch.description: JSON merge-patch; every field optional, `null` clears.

at_message_id.description: Copy history up to and including this message; default the whole session.

Author.description: Who wrote a message. Agents in rooms are identified by their seat, see `Message.seat_id`.

ContentBlock.description: One block of message content. Attachments are referenced by id; bytes come from `url`.

url.description: Filled by the server on read; ignored on write.

transcript.description: Filled when the hub transcribed the note before sending it to the agent.

ToolCall.description: One tool invocation inside an assistant message. Tool output lives here, not in a separate message.

preview.description: One-line summary for the tool card (a command, a path).

subagent_id.description: Set when the call was made by a delegated subagent.

MessageRole.description: `command` is a user message that starts with `/`; there is no `tool` role — tool output lives in `tool_calls`.

Handoff.description: Set on a room message that hands the turn to another seat.

allOf.description: The one message shape for sessions and rooms (see DECISIONS.md).

seat_id.description: The room seat that wrote an agent message.

seq.description: Position in the session; gaps mean deleted messages.

run_id.description: Stable across the user message, the assistant reply and its tool calls, so clients fold them into one run card.

id.description: The user, seat, task, schedule, workflow run or chain that caused the run.

allOf.description: One turn of an agent, executed as a job. Every run belongs to a session.

model.description: One-off override; the session's model is unchanged.

when.description: What to do if a run is active — append to the queue, jump the queue, or interrupt the active run with this message.

allOf.description: A decision the agent is waiting for — a tool approval, a write approval, a question, a plan, or a workflow step gate.

command.description: The exact command or write the agent wants to perform.

ApprovalResponse.description: `decision` for approvals; `answer` (free text or a choice value) for questions; both allowed.

url.description: Path of the bytes; fetch with the bearer header.

AgentKind.description: Which adapter drives the agent (ADR 0002). `builtin` is the hub's own lightweight agent.

AgentSection.description: The rows shown under the agent's card, in order (NAVIGATION §4).

limited.description: True for the process harness — the UI marks the agent "limited".

path.description: Display path (may start with `~`); never a hub-internal absolute path.

config.description: Stored verbatim; secret-looking values read as `[stored]`.

manageable.description: Whether `PATCH` may toggle it (false for bundled plugins).

entries.description: Sub-entries of preset-style plugins; `enabled` may be `conditional`.

exclusive.description: One identity may belong to a single workspace.

login.description: Set when the platform pairs interactively via `/login` instead of fields.

every_turns.description: Re-summarize the room every N turns; 0 disables.

SeatExecutor.description: Where the seat's agent runs — on the hub or on a linked device (Phase 3).

SeatConfig.description: The editable part of a seat; also the body of a seat preset.

invite_code.description: Only managers see it; others get `null`.

can_manage.description: Whether the caller may edit the room.

can_mention_all.description: Whether a person may address every seat at once with `@all`.

lead_seat_id.description:
The seat that answers a message that mentions nobody (DECISIONS §69). The first
seat added becomes the lead; `null` means such a message is only read.

archived_at.description: Set while the room is archived; an archived room refuses new messages.

runs.description: Active and queued runs across seats.

lead_seat_id.description: A seat of this room, or `null` for no default responder.

archived.description: Archive (`true`) or bring back (`false`) the room.

available.description: False when the agent or model it names is no longer usable.

working_dir.description: Repository checkout on the hub host; worktrees are created beside it.

report_room_id.description: Room where assigned agents post progress.

TaskStatus.description: The nine columns, in workflow order. `triage` is intake, `running` belongs to the worker.

auto_start.description: Start a run as soon as the task is `ready` and assigned.

position.description: Fractional index within the column; the server keeps it, clients never compute it.

session_id.description: The task session (source `task`) the assignee works in.

runs.description: Recent runs, newest first (max 20; the rest via the task session).

archived.description: `true` moves `done` tasks to `archived`; `false` restores them to `done`.

ScheduleTrigger.description: When to fire. `expression` for `cron` (5 fields), `every_minutes` for `interval`, `run_at` for `once`.

timezone.description: IANA zone the expression is evaluated in.

ScheduleTarget.description: What to run — a prompt to an agent, or a workflow.

DeliveryTarget.description: Where the output goes. `none` keeps it in history only.

run_if_missed.description: Whether a time missed while the hub was not running still runs, once, when the hub is back within 24 hours of it (DECISIONS §40). `false` skips it and records why in the history. A run up to two minutes late is on time and runs either way. `null` for a schedule in an agent's own scheduler (`external`), which decides this itself.

overlap.description: What happens when this schedule's time comes and its previous run is still going (DECISIONS §40): `skip` records the time as skipped; `wait` runs it as soon as the previous run ends, with at most one time waiting (a further one is skipped and recorded); `parallel` starts it alongside, in a session of its own; `replace` stops the previous run, then starts. "Run now" always starts at once and stops nothing. `null` for a schedule in an agent's own scheduler (`external`), which decides this itself.

ScheduleOverlap.description: What a schedule does when its time comes while its previous run is still going. See `Schedule.overlap`.

waiting.description: `true` while this time waits for the schedule's previous run to end (`overlap: wait`); its `status` is `queued`. It starts when that run ends.

output.description: Full text; only on the single-run read.

approval_required.description: Gate the node behind an approval (`kind: workflow_step`) before it runs.

session_id.description: The session where the step's agent worked; its output is that session's last assistant message.

steps.description: Latest attempt per node, in execution order.

key.description: `<provider slug>/<model>` — the value stored in sessions and seats.

custom.description: `true` registers a model the catalogue does not list.

api_key.description: A value sets the key; `""` or `null` clears it.

accepts_code.description: Whether the provider hands the user a code to paste back.

fallbacks.description: Tried in order when the chosen model fails.

active.description: At most one ensemble is active per workspace.

ready.description: Whether the hub can serve requests now (the phone's "server dictation possible" check).

voice.description: Overrides the provider's default voice for this request.

CapabilityKind.description: What a device can do for an agent. Unsupported kinds are simply absent.

consent_at.description: When the person granted the OS permission, if the device reports it.

DeviceRegistration.description: How a device describes itself when pairing.

device_key.description: Stable id the device generates once and keeps, so re-pairing updates the same row.

purpose.description: Shown to the person in the consent sheet.

code.description: Fixed list shared by all platforms.

events.description: Keyed by `NoticeKind`; a missing key means both channels on.

include_content.description: Include message text in payloads (off = ids only).

version.description: Release segment, e.g. `1.0.3`. Clients compare release then `build`.

download_url.description: Path on this hub; never a third-party URL.

source_url.description: Fetched server-side with the configured source token; the phone never sees it.

auto_publish.description: Publish new source releases automatically to the `test` channel.

data.description: Kind-specific; fixed in Phase 4 (usage totals and breakdowns, runtime processes, skill counts, log entries with ISO timestamps and byte sizes).

Envelope.description: Every event is wrapped in this envelope.

profile.description: `null` only for user-level events on /rt/devices (notices, device state).

seq.description: Monotonic per namespace and profile; a gap means the client missed events and refetches.
